R4_TUE17_manures_straw.caption:
Farmers, don't burn your paddy straw 🌾 It is free food for your soil.

3 better uses:
1️⃣ Mulch: spread it on the field. It keeps the soil moist and holds back weeds.
2️⃣ Compost: layer it with cow-dung slurry or jeevamrutham, keep it moist and turn it over.
3️⃣ Biochar: char it with very little air instead of burning it to ash. Always charge biochar with compost or jeevamrutham before use.

🎓 Want to learn these hands-on? We run practical training at our Bio-Input Resource Center.
